text:
Priya Patel: Quick copy review for the inline permission note in the console. Current: "You don't have permission. Contact your admin." Feels terse.
Ethan: Agreed. We have an access-request flow we can link to. Want short, neutral copy + clear CTA.
Maya: Accessibility: ensure focus moves into the panel and announce via aria-live. Also avoid contractions in strings (i18n).
Priya Patel: Drafts:
- "Access restricted 000Request access"
- "Access denied 000Request access"
Ethan: For the button/label use something descriptive: "Request access to workspace" (not just "Request"). Mobile width is tight so keep the main line to one short sentence.
Alex (eng): I'll test wrapping and hook up aria attributes. If it's too long we can show only "Access restricted" and rely on the action label.
Sam (DesignBot): Microcopy rules: primary action <=3 words, tone neutral, reason shown only when available (eg "Reason: restricted to org admins").
Priya Patel: Final mock strings I'll use:
Main: "Access restricted - Request access"
Action: "Request access to workspace"
Secondary (optional): "Reason: restricted to org admins"
Maya: LGTM. Priya, drop the code strings into the design file and I'll review wrapping.
Priya Patel: Done, will update artboard and notify once verified. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
